transcript:
Meeting header
Date: 2025-02-13
Time: 10:00 AM PST
Duration: 34 minutes
Attendees: Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood), Ben Carter (Redwood), Priya Natarajan (Redwood), Eli Turner (Northwind), Sana Qureshi (Northwind)

Summary (auto)
- Northwind reports usage totals higher than their internal estimates
- Root cause likely: client timeouts + retries counted as separate billable attempts; prompt tokens counted once admitted
- Agreed on written explanation + KB update

Transcript
[00:00] Vanessa Ortiz: Hey Eli, Sana, thanks for jumping on. We saw your note about the usage dashboard looking higher than your own numbers.
[00:16] Eli Turner: Yep. Its not like a few percent, its closer to twenty-ish. Were trying to reconcile before finance freaks out.
[00:33] Priya Natarajan: Totally. The quick clarification: Redwood accounts usage per attempt, and if your client retries after a timeout, both attempts can be billable depending on what happened server-side.
[00:52] Sana Qureshi: When you say "attempt", thats a single API call? Even if we didnt get a response?
[01:05] Ben Carter: Its the server-side admitted request. Even if the stream is cancelled client-side, prompt tokens are still counted once admitted. Completion tokens are what was actually generated/streamed before cancel.
[01:28] Eli Turner: Ok, thats probably the mismatch. We have a 15 second timeout and then we retry once. We assumed if it timed out then its not billed.
[01:46] Vanessa Ortiz: Makes sense. A lot of teams assume that. We should have made this clearer in docs.
[02:05] Priya Natarajan: Also, the Usage page groups by request_id which is the Redwood attempt id. So if you retry, youll see two request_ids.
[02:21] Sana Qureshi: Is there a way to de-dupe, like idempotency?
[02:30] Ben Carter: We can recommend patterns, but idempotency here is tricky because generation is not guaranteed identical. Operationally, best practice is: avoid automatic retries on client timeouts for long generations, or increase timeout, or use max_tokens that fits your SLA.
[03:02] Eli Turner: We can send you a days worth of retry metrics, sure.
[03:15] Vanessa Ortiz: Great. Well send a written explanation and a suggested client config.
[03:28] Priya Natarajan: And well add a KB page so the next person doesnt have to get on a call for this.
[03:40] Eli Turner: That works. If you can also confirm theres no double-counting bug, thats my main worry.
[03:54] Ben Carter: We checked a few sample request IDs and didnt see double counting, but well keep validating.
[04:10] Vanessa Ortiz: Cool. Well follow up EOD with the writeup + what we found.
